name: Underlying Transaction
definition: Reference information on a commercial obligation between the beneficiary and applicant for which an undertaking is issued.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of commercial obligation such as a tender, order, contract, etc.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date the commercial obligation was issued or awarded.

ContractAmountPercentage.name: Contract Amount Percentage
ContractAmountPercentage.definition: Percentage of the underlying contract covered by the undertaking.

Undertaking.name: Undertaking
Undertaking.definition: Undertaking issued to support a contract.

CommercialTrade.name: Commercial Trade
CommercialTrade.definition: Commercial trade for which an undertaking is issued.
